content.text: {"window_id":"w0030","observed_failures":[{"filename":"034.jpg","field":"date","predicted":"2018-08-09","note":"Receipt visibly shows 09/03/2018; agent output month/day swapped."},{"filename":"074.jpg","field":"total_amount","predicted":"702.00","note":"Receipt shows GRAND TOTAL 92.80 (Thai Delicious). Agent produced an unrelated value, likely picked up stray OCR digits or wrong line."},{"filename":"077.jpg","field":"total_amount","predicted":"23.26","note":"Receipt bold TOTAL: 23.25 (after -0.01 rounding adj). Agent took the pre-rounding 'Total (Inclusive of GST): 23.26' instead of the final TOTAL line."},{"filename":"078.jpg","field":"total_amount","predicted":"","note":"Prediction empty/blank string. Receipt has Grand Total 10.00. Agent emitted empty string instead of null, and also failed to extract despite clear 'GRAND TOTAL' keyword."}],"root_causes":[{"id":"rc_date_dmy_vs_mdy_ambiguity","description":"Date extraction treats numeric date tokens like 09/03/2018 ambiguously. The current skill lists both DD-MM-YYYY and generic patterns but does not enforce a locale preference; Malaysian/Singaporean receipts in this task use DD/MM/YYYY. The agent apparently parsed as MM/DD, producing 2018-08-09 instead of 2018-03-09."},{"id":"rc_total_tiebreak_last_vs_first","description":"When a receipt contains both a pre-rounding 'Total (Inclusive of GST)' line and a final 'TOTAL:' line after a rounding adjustment, the current rules do not specify which to pick. The skill says 'first matching line top-to-bottom' as one option, which selects the wrong 23.26 for 077.jpg. The correct behavior for receipts with explicit rounding/net totals is to prefer the LAST qualifying total (post-rounding) within the same tier."},{"id":"rc_null_vs_empty_string","description":"When extraction fails, the output cell is an empty string ('' as in 078.jpg) rather than a true null/empty cell. The current skill text already warns against this but the implementation did not enforce it; the rule needs to be stated as a mandatory serialization step with explicit code pattern (write None, not '', not NaN)."},{"id":"rc_ocr_robustness_for_faint_or_dense_receipts","description":"On faint photocopies and dense receipts (074.jpg Thai Delicious, 078.jpg myNEWS), the single preprocessing + PSM 6 pass misreads the total line. The multi-pass OCR section exists but is only invoked as a last resort; it should be the default for amount extraction, with voting across variants to pick the most consistent numeric answer near a priority keyword."},{"id":"rc_grand_total_two_line_handling","description":"078.jpg has 'SUB TOTAL  10.00' then 'GRAND TOTAL  10.00' on separate lines in sparse layout; the GRAND TOTAL amount sits on the same line in OCR output but with wide spacing. If the regex misses the trailing number due to layout noise, the two-line fallback should scan the next non-empty line, but it must also consider that the number may be on the SAME line separated by many spaces — current regex handles this, so the real miss is OCR not emitting the digits at all; mitigation is the multi-pass OCR default (rc_ocr_robustness_for_faint_or_dense_receipts)."}],"skill_defects":[{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"Date pattern list does not prioritize DD/MM/YYYY over MM/DD/YYYY for ambiguous numeric dates; no locale heuristic. Produces wrong month for e.g. 09/03/2018."},{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"Total-amount selection within a priority tier is under-specified. Does not instruct to prefer the LAST matching total line in the same tier when multiple candidates exist (e.g. pre-rounding vs post-rounding totals)."},{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"Does not explicitly disallow 'Total (Inclusive of GST)' / 'Total RM Incl.' pre-rounding lines when a subsequent 'TOTAL' / 'Total Rounded' / 'Net Total' / 'Rounded Total' line exists. Needs a secondary preference rule: post-rounding/net total beats pre-rounding total."},{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"Multi-pass OCR is presented as optional fallback. For receipt total/date extraction it should be the default, and the skill should describe a simple voting scheme across variants to pick the most frequently recovered numeric candidate adjacent to a priority keyword."},{"skill":"image-ocr","defect":"Null-vs-empty-string serialization rule exists in prose but no concrete pandas/openpyxl code pattern is given showing that an empty cell must be written as Python None (object dtype) so that round-trip reads it back as empty, not as ''."},{"skill":"xlsx","defect":"Does not warn that mixing numeric floats with string-formatted monetary values in the same column silently converts strings like '47.70' into floats on write, dropping trailing zeros. Needs an explicit guidance block for 'string-typed monetary columns' with object dtype and str formatting, applicable to any task that specifies a fixed decimal string representation."},{"skill":"xlsx","defect":"No guidance about writing null for failed extractions (None vs NaN vs empty string) when producing tabular outputs scored by exact string equality."}],"repair_recommendations":[{"skill":"image-ocr","change":"Add a 'Date disambiguation' subsection: when a date has three numeric groups and the first or second group is <=12 and the other is >12, assign unambiguously; otherwise default to DD/MM/YYYY (common for Malaysian/Singaporean receipts in this corpus). Reorder DATE_PATTERNS so DD-MM-YYYY is tried before MM-DD-YYYY, and remove any MM-DD-YYYY pattern unless an explicit textual month is present."},{"skill":"image-ocr","change":"Rewrite 'Total Amount Extraction' selection rules: (a) exclusions first; (b) scan all lines, collect every candidate within the highest-priority tier that has a match; (c) within that tier, prefer the LAST candidate line (post-rounding/net total) over earlier ones; (d) also demote lines containing 'INCLUSIVE OF GST', 'INCL GST', 'INCL. GST', 'EXCLUSIVE', 'EXCL' when a later 'TOTAL', 'TOTAL ROUNDED', 'NET TOTAL', 'ROUNDED TOTAL', or 'GRAND TOTAL' exists."},{"skill":"image-ocr","change":"Promote multi-pass OCR to the default pipeline for receipt field extraction: run (grayscale+autocontrast, 2x upscale, 3x upscale, SHARPEN) × (PSM 6, PSM 4, PSM 11), run date and total extraction on each variant, and vote: pick the amount value that appears most often across variants and is anchored to the highest-priority keyword; break ties by preferring the variant with the most non-empty keyword hits."},{"skill":"image-ocr","change":"Add explicit null-serialization code: show using pandas with dtype=object for both date and total_amount columns, writing Python None (not '', not float('nan')) when extraction returns None, so openpyxl stores a truly empty cell."},{"skill":"image-ocr","change":"Add a worked numeric-normalization example covering: strip RM/$/MYR prefix, strip trailing letters like 'A' or 'C' (common fuel-receipt artifacts), strip commas, reject obviously bad numerics (>1e6 or non-decimal when currency context expected), then format via f\"{v:.2f}\"."},{"skill":"image-ocr","change":"Add an 'Anti-patterns' table listing: picking the number from 'TOTAL INCLUDES 6% GST' (that is tax, not total), picking from 'Cash Tendered' / 'Change' (already in exclusions, but reinforce), picking 'AVERAGE / PAX', picking 'Total Savings' or discount lines; and keywords such as 'SAVING', 'DISCOUNT', 'PAX', 'TAX', 'GST' as exclusions when they appear anywhere in the line."},{"skill":"xlsx","change":"Add a short section 'String-typed monetary / fixed-decimal columns': recommend building a list of dicts with str values, constructing a DataFrame with explicit dtype=object for those columns, and using openpyxl engine; include a snippet showing that writing float 47.7 yields display 47.7 but writing str '47.70' preserves the required two-decimal representation."},{"skill":"xlsx","change":"Add a 'Null handling for exact-match graders' note: for any column where the task says 'null if extraction fails', write Python None, which openpyxl renders as an empty cell; warn that '' and 'None' strings and float NaN all fail exact-match evaluation."},{"skill":"xlsx","change":"Add a 'Sorting rule' reminder: when the task says 'ordered by filename', always sort lexicographically on the filename column before writing; do not rely on OS directory iteration order."}],"confidence":{"observed_failures":"high","root_causes":"high","skill_defects":"medium","repair_recommendations":"medium","notes":"Diagnosis grounded in the four failing field_feedback rows plus direct inspection of the 22 receipt images. Field feedback did not disclose oracle values; recommendations are structural rules, not value fixes."}}
